summary: EVAVO's Windows-first local ComfyUI image-generation control plane and agent transport layer. It owns native ComfyUI discovery/provisioning/health, model inventory, live workflow preflight, real prompt submission/completion/output collection, bounded batch execution, shared task history, MCP delivery to local hosts and secure ChatGPT tunnelling. Its optional hardened loopback gateway may delegate video/audio/3D work to separately governed sibling Studio providers without making those modalities owned MCP/package capabilities. Each gateway task-state file has one live gateway owner at a time; a second process fails closed instead of creating split-brain recovery semantics. The deterministic mock is test infrastructure only; Local Image Generator is not Art Studio, does not provide creative approval and cannot claim real image generation without a healthy native ComfyUI backend.

capabilities.title: Discover and health-check native ComfyUI backends
capabilities.description: Discover source/portable/external ComfyUI instances, probe live native endpoints and reuse healthy user-managed renderers without killing or replacing them merely because their filesystem install is not discoverable.
requires: Local/loopback ComfyUI endpoint for live readiness

capabilities.title: Provision an official native ComfyUI runtime when needed
capabilities.description: Reuse reviewed existing source/portable installs before optionally cloning/provisioning official ComfyUI, isolate source runtimes, validate Torch/CUDA/entrypoint readiness and never silently choose a diffusion model.

capabilities.title: Inventory local ComfyUI model resources
capabilities.description: Discover checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs, ControlNets, UNETs, text encoders, CLIP vision and upscalers including shared external model libraries without copying multi-gigabyte files.

capabilities.title: Preflight custom ComfyUI workflows without rendering
capabilities.description: Render the same template substitutions as generation and validate live node classes, required inputs and literal model/loader choices against the active backend without queueing a prompt or writing task history.

capabilities.title: Generate images through real native ComfyUI
capabilities.description: Submit standard or preflighted custom workflows to native ComfyUI, retain real prompt IDs, wait on history when requested and collect authorized output files atomically. Real generation cannot be satisfied by the deterministic EVAVO mock.

capabilities.title: Run bounded-concurrency image batches
capabilities.description: Run multiple generation requests with bounded concurrency, shared lock-protected task history and per-generation status/output evidence rather than launching unbounded renderer work.

capabilities.title: Track, collect and expose generated outputs for inspection
capabilities.description: Track prompt completion, collect outputs through native /view, atomically download authorized files and return generated images as native MCP image content so host models can inspect the actual result rather than only a Windows path.

capabilities.title: Maintain shared generation task history and statistics
capabilities.description: Maintain lock-protected atomic task history shared by CLI and MCP and expose bounded status/statistics for operational diagnosis without treating history as creative approval.

capabilities.title: Expose local image-generation MCP services
capabilities.description: Serve MCP v2 over stdio and private loopback Streamable HTTP, configure Claude Desktop and optionally start the private HTTP MCP at Windows login without making the loopback endpoint public directly.

capabilities.title: Bridge private workstation MCP to ChatGPT securely
capabilities.description: Configure the supported outbound OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel using a pre-existing tunnel ID/runtime key, verify downloaded tunnel-client release integrity and protect persisted runtime keys with current-user Windows DPAPI rather than exposing local loopback directly.

capabilities.title: Expose a hardened private loopback compatibility gateway
capabilities.description: Expose REST/WebSocket compatibility only on loopback with CORS disabled by default, structured configuration validation, pre-parse request-body caps including chunked bodies, bounded project/timeout fields, default-denied and owner-root-confined per-request workflow paths, atomic task persistence, fail-closed corrupt state and a lifetime instance lock that permits exactly one live gateway owner per task-state file. A competing process fails with GATEWAY_STATE_IN_USE instead of producing split-brain recovery behavior.
requires: Native ComfyUI for healthy owned image generation
Unique task-state file per simultaneously running gateway instance

capabilities.title: Delegate optional gateway media to governed sibling Studio providers
capabilities.description: Keep image ownership in this repository while allowing the loopback compatibility gateway to delegate video, audio and 3D tasks only to readiness-checked sibling providers. Provider execution is fail-closed, receipt-backed, timeout-bounded, output-confined and digest-verified when a receipt supplies a hash; unavailable providers produce structured failures rather than fake completion.
requires: Explicitly ready reviewed provider for the requested delegated modality

capabilities.title: Run repository and Windows integration verification
capabilities.description: Run read-only structural verification plus full root, repository-level provider and package safety/integration checks, optionally requiring PowerShell AST validation, and distinguish mock contract tests from real native-backend readiness.
requires: Native ComfyUI only for live generation validation
